feature_descriptions.Early_Engagement_Index: Early activity composite indicator (predicts trajectory before disengagement)
feature_descriptions.Engagement_Score: Overall composite measure of multi-modal activity across course lifecycle
feature_descriptions.Video_Completion: Percentage of lecture and instructional video content completed
feature_descriptions.Login_Frequency: Total platform login occurrences during active course window
feature_descriptions.Assignment_Submissions: Formal assessment and project submissions completed
feature_descriptions.Relative_Video_Completion: Learner video progress compared against course-wide cohort average
feature_descriptions.Quiz_Attempts: Formative and summative quiz participation frequency
feature_descriptions.Relative_Login_Frequency: Login activity rate relative to specific course cohort average
feature_descriptions.Discussion_Activity: Community forum posts, responses, and peer discussion interactions
feature_descriptions.Assignment_Participation_Rate: Normalized submission rate relative to maximum course tasks
feature_descriptions.Quiz_Activity_Rate: Normalized quiz attempt frequency against cohort benchmark
feature_descriptions.Discussion_Participation: Relative forum participation index within course community
